title: Trip to Kyoto

lines.en: Hi Chloe, welcome back! How was your trip to Kyoto?
lines.zh: 嗨 Chloe，歡迎回來！你的京都之旅怎麼樣？

lines.en: It was wonderful, thanks. I'm still a little tired, though.
lines.zh: 很棒，謝謝。不過我還是有點累。

lines.en: Was it your first time in Japan?
lines.zh: 那是你第一次去日本嗎？

lines.en: Yes, it was. Have you ever been there?
lines.zh: 是的。你有去過嗎？

lines.en: Yes, twice. I went to Tokyo and Osaka, but never Kyoto.
lines.zh: 有，去過兩次。我去過東京和大阪，但從沒去過京都。

lines.en: You should go. The old temples are beautiful.
lines.zh: 你應該去。那些古老的寺廟很美。

lines.en: What was your favorite place?
lines.zh: 你最喜歡哪個地方？

lines.en: A small temple on a hill. I happened to run into a friendly guide there.
lines.zh: 山丘上的一間小寺廟。我在那裡剛好碰到一位很親切的導遊。

lines.en: Really? What did he tell you?
lines.zh: 真的嗎？他跟你說了什麼？

lines.en: He told us the history of the temple. It was over a thousand years old.
lines.zh: 他告訴我們這間寺廟的歷史。它有一千多年了。

lines.en: That's amazing. Did you plan everything before you left?
lines.zh: 太驚人了。你出發前有把一切都規劃好嗎？

lines.en: I made a simple itinerary, but I didn't follow it very well.
lines.zh: 我做了一份簡單的行程表，但沒有照著走得很好。

lines.en: Why not?
lines.zh: 為什麼？

lines.en: Well, the trains were confusing at first. It took me a while to figure out the map.
lines.zh: 嗯，一開始電車很讓人搞不懂。我花了好一陣子才弄懂地圖。

lines.en: Ha, I know that feeling. Tokyo's station was the same for me.
lines.zh: 哈，我懂那種感覺。東京的車站對我來說也一樣。

lines.en: Yes! I got lost on the first day. I thought I would end up in the wrong city.
lines.zh: 對！我第一天就迷路了。我還以為會跑到錯的城市去。

lines.en: But you didn't, right?
lines.zh: 但你沒有，對吧？

lines.en: No. A kind woman helped me find the right platform.
lines.zh: 沒有。一位好心的女士幫我找到正確的月台。

lines.en: People in Japan are so helpful. Have you ever tried to speak Japanese?
lines.zh: 日本人真的很樂於助人。你有試過說日文嗎？

lines.en: Only a little. I learned some basic words before the trip.
lines.zh: 只有一點點。出發前我學了一些基本單字。

lines.en: Like what?
lines.zh: 像是什麼？

lines.en: Things like "thank you" and "delicious". They made everyone smile.
lines.zh: 像是「謝謝」和「好吃」。這些讓大家都笑了。

lines.en: Nice. What about the food? Did you try anything new?
lines.zh: 不錯。那食物呢？你有試什麼新東西嗎？

lines.en: Everything was new! I had a bowl of hot noodles at a small shop near the hotel.
lines.zh: 每樣都是新的！我在飯店附近的小店吃了一碗熱騰騰的麵。

lines.en: Was it good?
lines.zh: 好吃嗎？

lines.en: It was the best I've ever had. I went back three times.
lines.zh: 那是我吃過最好吃的。我回去了三次。

lines.en: Three times! I'd do the same thing.
lines.zh: 三次！我也會那樣做。

lines.en: Have you ever eaten at a place that was so good that you didn't want to leave?
lines.zh: 你有沒有在某家店吃得太好，好到不想離開過？

lines.en: Yes, once in Osaka. I stayed there for two hours.
lines.zh: 有，在大阪有一次。我在那裡待了兩個小時。

lines.en: That's how I felt. Next time, I want to visit in autumn.
lines.zh: 我就是那種感覺。下次我想秋天去。

lines.en: What would you recommend for the best time to go?
lines.zh: 你會建議什麼時候去最好？

lines.en: Mid-November. The red leaves are gorgeous then.
lines.zh: 十一月中旬。那時候的紅葉美極了。

lines.en: Sounds perfect. Maybe I'll book a trip for next autumn.
lines.zh: 聽起來太棒了。也許我明年秋天就訂行程。

lines.en: Do it! You won't regret it.
lines.zh: 去吧！你不會後悔的。

lines.en: Now I just have to save some money.
lines.zh: 現在我只要存點錢就好。

lines.en: Same here. My wallet is empty after this trip!
lines.zh: 我也是。這趟旅行之後我的錢包空空的！

lines.en: Ha! Well, thanks for the stories. I feel like I traveled too.
lines.zh: 哈！謝謝你分享這些故事。我覺得自己好像也去旅行了。

lines.en: Anytime. I'll show you my photos at lunch.
lines.zh: 隨時都可以。午餐時我給你看我的照片。

quiz.why: Chloe 說一開始電車很讓人搞不懂，她花了一陣子才弄懂地圖。

When does Chloe suggest going to Kyoto?
quiz.why: 她說十一月中旬的紅葉很美。

speaking.pattern: Have you ever + 過去分詞 ...?
speaking.patternZh: 你有沒有……過？（問對方的經驗）

part2.q: When is the shipment leaving the factory?
opts: Yes, it was a long trip.
part2.why: 問 When（何時），要回答時間。B 是地點（Where 的答案），A 的 trip 跟 ship 聯想是陷阱。
part2.zh: 這批貨什麼時候離開工廠？

part2.q: Could you send me the meeting schedule?
part2.why: Could you 是請求，答 Sure 最自然。B 重複 meeting 是陷阱，C 的 No 不通順。
part2.zh: 你可以把會議時間表寄給我嗎？

part2.q: Why don't we move the meeting to Friday?
part2.why: Why don't we 是建議，不是真的問原因。That works for me 是同意。A 把它當成 Why 來回答是陷阱。
part2.zh: 我們何不把會議改到星期五？

part2.q: Do you want tea or coffee?
opts: I just came from the store.
part2.why: 選擇問句（A or B）不能用 Yes/No 回答，直接選一個。

part2.q: Who is in charge of the training session?
opts: Ms. Lin from the HR team.
part2.why: 問 Who（誰），要回答人。B 是地點，C 是時間長度。
